title: Dine at MOLLIE Aspen | Aspen Cafe, Restaurant, Bar and Lounge
content:
Petit Trois
ABOUT PETIT TROIS
Petit Trois at MOLLIE Aspen is a full-service restaurant and the vibrant culinary heart of the hotel. Brought to life by celebrated Chef Ludo Lefebvre, this marks the acclaimed French bistro’s very first location outside of Los Angeles. By blending timeless Parisian charm with Aspen’s soulful mountain energy, we invite guests and locals alike to gather over classic French cuisine in an unforgettable alpine setting.
Restaurant & Bar
BREAKFAST: 7:00AM - 11:00AM
LUNCH: 11:30AM - 2:00PM
DINNER: 5:00PM - 9:00PM
BRUNCH (SAT+SUN): 7:00AM - 2:00PM
Petit Trois Aspen is an award-winning Parisian-inspired bistro from Chef Ludo Lefebvre. Hailing from Burgundy, Chef Ludo brings his signature flair to classic French dishes, turning simple classics into something extra special.
The full-service dining space serves daily breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The bar is an inviting destination, with elegant and complex cocktails, a curated wine list, and a thoughtful selection of beers and ciders.
Cafe & Wine Bar
BREAKFAST: 7:00AM - 11:00AM
LUNCH: 11:00AM - 3:00PM
WINE BAR: 3:00PM - 9:00PM
Nestled within MOLLIE, the Cafe offers Sightglass coffee, perfectly blended matcha lattes, and a variety of Rishi Select Teas. It also features a selection of prepared breakfast and pastry options, and a special lunch menu from Petit Trois.
In the afternoon it transitions to a Wine Bar with a snack menu by Chef Ludo and an exciting wine list, including a significant number of wines by the glass.
Petit Familia
OPEN WED-SUN: 4:00PM-10:00PM
CLOSED 10/10 & 10/16 FOR PRIVATE EVENTS
ABOUT PETIT FAMILIA
Located on the third floor, Petit Familia is an intimate indoor/outdoor lounge with unparalleled views of Aspen Mountain. The menu celebrates the versatility of tequila and mezcal in signature cocktails, and also includes thoughtfully-crafted NA drinks and a well-curated beer and wine list. Chef Ludo Lefebvre’s delicious bar snacks combine the precision of Petit Trois with the playfulness of Trois Familia to create a new, only-in-Aspen experience.
Roof Terrace Bar
OPEN WED-SUN: 4:00PM-10:00PM
CLOSED 10/10, & 10/16 FOR PRIVATE EVENTS
The Roof Terrace Bar, Petit Familia, is an intimate 3rd floor lounge offering unparalleled views of Aspen Mountain. The bar celebrates the rich versatility of agave spirits with signature tequila and mezcal cocktails, and an innovative French-Mexican menu of bar snacks from Chef Ludo Lefebvre.
